$comment: FNO music map — starting values from 20-Music-Scene-Entries.md §2/§5 as ruled by Dan. Seconds. trigger = a screen id (screen:menu, screen:opening-dedication, screen:console, …) or a node id (node:<id>) entered; stop_on = input ids (start-new, start-load, skip-to-menu, choose:<option id>) or screen ids that fade the cue out. No loops on any screen where the player reads and decides. A cue may carry a gain (0-1) applied to that cue only. All numbers are tunable without a rebuild; cues marked provisional are expected to move after playtest 2. Nothing here enters the ledger, the log, or the replay.

cues.note: Under the dedication, the notices and the hero title; crossfades into menu-loop. 0:42 is a section change; if the player is still reading at 0:42 the cue extends to the next seam at 2:04.
Dan: the refrain loop 1:00 → 1:52 stands. Fades over 2 s on New Campaign or Continue.

Playtest 2 (note 9): Mission in Danger Drum Background at cue gain 0.75 (25 % lower). Runs once through the stabilization report, the rule, the return briefing and the decision; silence after 2:06 is intended. Tune the start offset first, then the fade on Choose.
Dan's ruling: start at 1:30. Runs out naturally at 1:46; no retrigger for the IX-A briefing. Alternative if too short in play: start 64.0.
